storylines.title: The Taipei Visit
basis: China's president made a state visit to Washington, Sept. 22–24, 2026, pressing the U.S. to 'oppose' Taiwan independence (ISW, BBC, Guardian)
A $14 billion Taiwan arms package has been delayed (ISW, National Post)
ticker: State visit ends with trade truce extended to Jan. 10
$14B Taiwan arms package still on hold
Beijing: arms sales to Taiwan are a 'red line'
storylines.pres_line: At dawn, the People's Republic of China attacked Taiwan, and American forces in the Pacific.

vo: It began with a red carpet. In Washington, China's president pressed the White House to oppose Taiwan independence.
A week later, a congressional delegation landed in Taipei, and Congress moved to release fourteen billion dollars in arms.
Beijing answered within hours. Live-fire drills, code-named Strait Thunder.

shots.sub: CHINESE FIGHTER STRIKES U.S. NAVY P-8
vo: Then a Chinese fighter clipped a U.S. Navy P-8 over the strait. Nine Americans are missing.
Two carrier strike groups turned toward Taiwan.
At dawn, the drills went live.
Real world, real world. Incoming missile. Seek shelter immediately.
Defense readiness condition two is now in effect.

storylines.title: The Wonsan Test
basis: North Korea test-fired two missiles from the Wonsan area on Sept. 20, 2026, later called a new Hwasong-11Ma hypersonic system (AP, Janes, TWZ)
Pyongyang condemned U.S.–South Korea–Japan drills (CNN, PBS)
ticker: Pyongyang: new hypersonic weapon an 'incurable headache'
Seoul: missiles flew 450 and 600 km from Wonsan
Japan: both landed outside its EEZ
Kim Yo Jong dismisses U.S. overture
storylines.pres_line: At dawn, North Korea attacked our ally, and China joined the assault on American forces.

vo: From Wonsan, North Korea tested a new hypersonic missile, and promised Washington an incurable headache.
As allied forces drilled together, Pyongyang declared a wartime state along the DMZ.
Then the guns opened up on Yeonpyeong Island.
Tonight, missiles over Seoul. Patriot batteries are firing.
In Beijing, the P-L-A went to its highest alert, and warships surged into the Taiwan Strait.
Real world, real world. Incoming missile, Camp Humphreys. Seek shelter immediately.
Two American carriers are racing north.
Defense readiness condition two is now in effect.

storylines.title: Second Thomas Shoal
basis: On Sept. 24, 2026, PLA Navy and China Coast Guard ships blocked a Philippine resupply mission to BRP Sierra Madre at Second Thomas Shoal, warning of 'compulsory measures' (USNI News, Rappler, Philstar)
storylines.pres_line: At dawn, the People's Republic of China attacked our ally, the Philippines, and American forces.

vo: At Second Thomas Shoal, Chinese warships turned back a Philippine resupply mission, and threatened compulsory measures.
Manila tried again, with an American destroyer in escort.
A Chinese cutter rammed the supply boat. Four Filipino sailors were killed. Manila invoked the Mutual Defense Treaty.
Carriers were ordered into the South China Sea.
Just after midnight, missiles struck bases on Luzon, where Americans are stationed.
Real world, real world. Incoming missile. Seek shelter immediately.
Defense readiness condition two is now in effect.
